description: Complete data lifecycle and state transition map across TARA subsystems

data_stages.description: Raw user query, audio frame, or sensory telemetric input
data_stages.output_format: Normalized Unicode string, audio features, sensor frame

data_stages.description: Assembly of multi-turn conversational context, user profile, and memory recall
data_stages.output_format: SessionContext with top-k retrieved semantic episodes

data_stages.description: Retrieval of verified axioms, domain knowledge, and specialist computations
data_stages.output_format: Verified knowledge excerpts, mathematical derivations, scientific concepts

data_stages.description: Evaluation of candidate actions against immutable safety rules and operator permissions
data_stages.output_format: Gated action permissions, audit proof record

data_stages.description: Auto-regressive token generation across 22 transformer layers
data_stages.output_format: Streamed text tokens + control action tokens

data_stages.description: Execution of skills, tools, and robotic motor movements
data_stages.output_format: Execution output payload, error traces, telemetry logs

data_stages.description: Post-action verification against derivations and reasoning quality scoring
data_stages.output_format: Task verification verdict, reward credit event

data_stages.description: Recording turn episode, extracting lessons, and queuing training candidates
data_stages.output_format: EpisodeRecord, experiential lesson, staged training batch

data_stages.description: Updating world state: entity tracking, relationship delta, causal inference, state change propagation, and uncertainty bounds from observation results
data_stages.output_format: WorldStateSnapshot: entities, relationships, causal_chains, time_delta, confidence_bounds

data_stages.description: Goal decomposition, priority assignment, dependency resolution, plan construction, and reward linkage
data_stages.output_format: GoalPlan: priority-ordered task decomposition with dependency graph and safety authority chain

data_stages.description: Unified perception layer ingests Text, Audio, Vision (future), Documents, and Sensor streams and maps them to a canonical cognitive representation before entering TaraBrain

modalities.text: Normalized UTF-8 string — language engine handles script detection and multi-language routing
modalities.audio: Voice transcription via TTS/ASR engine → normalized text + prosodic metadata
modalities.vision: PLANNED — image/video frame → perceptual feature vector → cognitive_loop
modalities.documents: PDF/markdown ingestion → structured text → knowledge pipeline
modalities.sensors: Hardware telemetry (RoboticsHal sensor fusion) → state vector → world model update

data_stages.output_format: CanonicalPerceptionUnit: modality, content, confidence, timestamp, actor_id

data_stages.description: Full robotics control chain: sensor observation → state estimation → world model → plan → safety check → actuator → feedback loop
chain: RoboticsHal::estimate_state — compute joint angles and end-effector pose
WorldStateTracker::update_entity — sync estimated state into world model
cognitive_loop plan — TaraBrain generates motion trajectory
SensorFusionBuffer::verify_position — confirm encoder feedback matches target
RecoveryEngine::emergency_stop — arm kill-switch on anomaly detection

storage_mounts.storage/models/: Neural model weights, tokenizer configs, and versions manifest
storage_mounts.storage/memory/: User episodic memory files and vector indices
storage_mounts.storage/knowledge/: Domain partitions, inverted index, and axiomatic relationship graph
storage_mounts.storage/datasets/: Filtered canonical/weak shards and provenance metadata
storage_mounts.storage/persistence/: Self-model, experiential lessons, world model state, and goal hierarchy states
storage_mounts.storage/vault/: HMAC manifest seals and cryptographic access keys
storage_mounts.storage/datasets/curriculum/: Academic curriculum datasets and coverage matrix
storage_mounts.TARA/SKILLS/: Native declarative skill specifications and catalogs
storage_mounts.TARA/ACCESS/: Operator access registries and trust roots
